preflight.reason: witness co-signer unavailable; required WITNESS_COSIGNED, only SOFTWARE_KEY reachable — operation blocked

refusal_record.reason: witness co-signer unavailable; required WITNESS_COSIGNED, only SOFTWARE_KEY reachable — operation blocked
refusal_record.honest_note: The operation was blocked before it ran. Nothing on the target was read, written, or destroyed. This entry exists so that a blocked attempt is distinguishable from an attempt that was never made.

phases.meaning: With the witness down, the operation was blocked before the destructive step, and the blocked attempt is itself in the chain as a REFUSED entry carrying no co-signature. Unplugging the co-signer is a way to LOG an operation, not a way to hide one.
